edges.description: TTLL5 is the glutamylase for RPGR-ORF15, so loss of TTLL5 activity abolishes the modification.
In sperm, TTLL5 polyglutamylates axonemal alpha-tubulin; truncating loss removes this activity.
Glutamylation is required for RPGR-ORF15 function at the connecting cilium; without it, cone opsins mislocalize as in RPGR-null mice.

nodes.description: TTLL5 glutamylates the glutamate- and glycine-rich repeat region of the photoreceptor-specific RPGR-ORF15 isoform. The RPGR C-terminal basic domain binds TTLL5's cofactor interaction domain, which targets the enzyme to RPGR; disease mutations at that interface abolish the interaction. Without TTLL5, RPGR-ORF15 is not glutamylated.
